verdict.rationale: Composio is API/SDK-first with a documented OpenAPI spec, CLI, session/MCP creation endpoints, and toolkit configuration all exposed programmatically (composio-probe-2, composio-docs-1, composio-docs-23, composio-docs-35), suggesting most functionality is API-native by design. However, some settings (e.g. white-labeling branding, logo/theme) are explicitly described as configured 'in the dashboard' with no documented API equivalent shown. Missing for 10: explicit API endpoints for dashboard-only settings like white-labeling/branding, and independent confirmation that no UI-only feature exists.
